select the most appropriate option to fill in each blank.

an orphan who is (1)________ by his guardian aunt and uncle and their son. On his 11th
birthday Harry discovers that his parents were a witch and a wizard and that he, a wizard
himself, has been invited to (2)______ Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry. He also
learns that his parents had not (3)_______ in a car accident, as his aunt and uncle had told

the only person to have ever (4) ______ an attack by Voldemort—by somehow (5)_______
the latter’s ‘killing curse’—which left him with a lightning-bolt-shaped scar on his forehead.
